draft.shortGloss: to finish; to end; to terminate
notes: Use 'beenden' when you actively stop or complete a process, a task, or a relationship. It sounds more formal and decisive than the common verb 'aufhören' (to stop doing something).
Distinguish 'beenden' (to finish something) from 'enden' (to come to an end). 'Der Film endet' (the film ends on its own), but 'Ich beende den Film' (I end the film).
